arxiv-1902-10814.creator: Da-Cheng Juan, Chun-Ta Lu, Zhen Li, Futang Peng, Aleksei Timofeev, Yi-Ting Chen, Yaxi Gao, Tom Duerig, Andrew Tomkins, Sujith Ravi
arxiv-1902-10814.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Da-Cheng Juan, Chun-Ta Lu, Zhen Li, Futang Peng, Aleksei Timofeev, Yi-Ting Chen, Yaxi Gao, Tom Duerig, Andrew Tomkins, Sujith Ravi. Learning image representations to capture fine-grained semantics has been a challenging and important task enabling many applications such as image search and clustering. In this paper, we present Graph-Regularized Image Semantic Embedding (Graph-RISE), a large-scale neural graph learning framework that allows us to train embeddings to discriminate an unprecedented 𝒪 ⁡ ( 40 ​ M ) \mathcal{O}(40M) ultra-fine-grained semantic labels.

arxiv-2202-02392.title: Fractional-Order Shell Theory: Formulation and Application to the Analysis of Nonlocal Cylindrical Panels
arxiv-2202-02392.creator: Sai Sidhardh, Sansit Patnaik, Fabio Semperlotti
arxiv-2202-02392.description: Abstract We present a theoretical and computational framework based on fractional calculus for the analysis of the nonlocal static response of cylindrical shell panels. The differ-integral nature of fractional derivatives allows an efficient and accurate methodology to account for the effect of long-range (nonlocal) interactions in curved structures.

arxiv-2401-08610.title: Leverage Staking with Liquid Staking Derivatives (LSDs): Opportunities and Risks
arxiv-2401-08610.creator: Xihan Xiong, Zhipeng Wang, Xi Chen, William Knottenbelt, Michael Huth
arxiv-2401-08610.description: Abstract In the Proof of Stake (PoS) Ethereum ecosystem, users can stake ETH on Lido to receive stETH , a Liquid Staking Derivative (LSD) that represents staked ETH and accrues staking rewards. LSDs improve the liquidity of staked assets by facilitating their use in secondary markets, such as for collateralized borrowing on Aave or asset exchanges on Curve.

arxiv-2407-20144.title: Deciphering the Instability of the Black Hole Ringdown Quasinormal Spectrum
arxiv-2407-20144.creator: A. Ianniccari, A. J. Iovino, A. Kehagias, P. Pani, G. Perna, D. Perrone, A. Riotto
arxiv-2407-20144.description: Abstract The spectrum of the quasinormal modes of the gravitational waves emitted during the ringdown phase following the merger of two black holes is of primary importance in gravitational astronomy. However, the spectrum is extremely sensitive to small disturbances of the system, thus potentially jeopardizing the predictions of the gravitational wave observables.

arxiv-2501-19279.title: S-VOTE: Similarity-based Voting for Client Selection in Decentralized Federated Learning
arxiv-2501-19279.creator: Pedro Miguel Sánchez Sánchez 1,2,* , Enrique Tomás Martínez Beltrán 1 , Chao Feng 3 Gérôme Bovet 4 , Gregorio Martínez Pérez 1 , Alberto Huertas Celdrán 1,3
arxiv-2501-19279.description: Abstract Decentralized Federated Learning (DFL) enables collaborative, privacy-preserving model training without relying on a central server. This decentralized approach reduces bottlenecks and eliminates single points of failure, enhancing scalability and resilience. However, DFL also introduces challenges such as suboptimal models with non-IID data distributions, increased communication overhead, and resource usage.

arxiv-2503-20578.title: LLPut: Investigating Large Language Models for Bug Report-Based Input Generation Conference: 33rd ACM International Conference on the Foundations of Software Engineering; June 23–28, 2025; Trondheim, Norway 33rd ACM International Conference on the Foundations of Software Engineering (FSE Companion ’
arxiv-2503-20578.creator: Alif Al Hasan, Subarna Saha, Mia Mohammad Imran, Tarannum Shaila Zaman
arxiv-2503-20578.description: Abstract . Failure-inducing inputs play a crucial role in diagnosing and analyzing software bugs. Bug reports typically contain these inputs, which developers extract to facilitate debugging. Since bug reports are written in natural language, prior research has leveraged various Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques for automated input extraction.

arxiv-2507-15093.title: Exact Finite Koopman Embedding of Block-Oriented Polynomial Systems Thanks: Submitted to the editors on the 12 th of July, 2025 .
arxiv-2507-15093.creator: Lucian Cristian Iacob, Roland Tóth ,, Maarten Schoukens
arxiv-2507-15093.description: Abstract The challenge of finding exact and finite-dimensional Koopman embeddings of nonlinear systems has been largely circumvented by employing data-driven techniques to learn models of different complexities (e.g., linear, bilinear, input affine). Although these models may provide good accuracy, selecting the model structure and dimension is still ad-hoc and it is difficult to quantify the error that is introduced.

arxiv-2507-21388.title: A comparative study of time on Mars with lunar and terrestrial clocks
arxiv-2507-21388.creator: Neil Ashby, Bijunath R. Patla
arxiv-2507-21388.description: Abstract As space exploration extends into cislunar space and further towards Mars, understanding the relativistic effects on clocks on Mars—particularly in relation to multi-body gravitational influences—becomes increasingly important for accurate clock synchronization. This study estimates clock rates on Mars and compares them to those on the Moon and Earth.

pmc-10507059.title: Enhancing scientific transparency in national CO2 emissions reports via satellite-based a posteriori estimates
pmc-10507059.creator: Masataka Watanabe, Akihiro Oba, Yoko Saito, Gomboluudev Purevjav, Batjargal Gankhuyag, Munkhbat Byamba-Ochir, Batjargal Zamba, Tomohiro Shishime
pmc-10507059.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Biennial Update Reports (BURs) are essential requirements from the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC). However, many non-Annex I countries have not submitted these reports due to difficulties in compiling the inventories. We developed a satellite-based method for the top-down inverse estimation of CO2 emissions using partial-column data in the lower troposphere obtained by the Greenhouse Gases Observing Satellite, adopted to validate the Mongolian 2nd BUR (BUR2) for the energy sector in 2018.

pmc-10574761.title: Novel 1,2,3-Triazole-Containing Quinoline–Benzimidazole Hybrids: Synthesis, Antiproliferative Activity, In Silico ADME Predictions, and Docking
pmc-10574761.creator: Luka Krstulović, Katarina Mišković Špoljarić, Vesna Rastija, Nikolina Filipović, Miroslav Bajić, Ljubica Glavaš-Obrovac
pmc-10574761.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The newly synthesized quinoline–benzimidazole hybrids containing two types of triazole-methyl-phenoxy linkers were characterized via NMR and elemental analysis. Additional derivatization was achieved by introducing bromine at the C-2 position of the phenoxy core. These novel hybrids were tested for their effects on the growth of the non-tumor cell line MRC-5 (human fetal lung fibroblasts), leukemia and lymphoma cell lines: Hut78, THP-1 and HL-60, and carcinoma cell lines: HeLa and CaCo-2.

pmc-10689478.title: Extraction-free LAMP assays for generic detection of Old World Orthopoxviruses and specific detection of Mpox virus
pmc-10689478.creator: Zhiru Li, Amit Sinha, Yinhua Zhang, Nathan Tanner, Hui-Ting Cheng, Prem Premsrirut, Clotilde K S Carlow
pmc-10689478.description: Mpox is a neglected zoonotic disease endemic in West and Central Africa. The Mpox outbreak with more than 90,000 cases worldwide since 2022 generated great concern about future outbreaks and highlighted the need for a simple and rapid diagnostic test.

pmc-11460865.title: Cone beam computed tomography changes upon oral appliance therapy for adult patients with obstructive sleep apnea: A non-randomized clinical trial
pmc-11460865.creator: Lina Khasawneh, Noor Al Mortadi, Eslam Abu-Ishqair, Basheer Khassawneh, Karem H. Alzoubi
pmc-11460865.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background:Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) is caused by narrowing or obstruction of the airway lumen at single or multiple levels of the airway, starting from the nasal cavity up to the larynx. Oral appliance therapy for the management of OSA is prescribed as an alternative treatment option for patients with mild to moderate OSA who fail to adhere to Continuous Positive Airway Pressure (CPAP) therapy.

pmc-11676367.title: The Role of Pharmacometrics in Advancing the Therapies for Autoimmune Diseases
pmc-11676367.creator: Artur Świerczek, Dominika Batko, Elżbieta Wyska, Anil Jegga
pmc-11676367.description: Autoimmune diseases (AIDs) are a group of disorders in which the immune system attacks the body’s own tissues, leading to chronic inflammation and organ damage. These diseases are difficult to treat due to variability in drug PK among individuals, patient responses to treatment, and the side effects of long-term immunosuppressive therapies.

pmc-12692692.title: Patient-Centred and Daily Life-Oriented Botulinum Toxin Treatment for Stroke Survivors with Upper Extremity Spasticity—Effects and Practical Aspects
pmc-12692692.creator: Sybille Roschka, David Punt, Thomas Platz, Mihai Berteanu
pmc-12692692.description: Background/Objectives: To investigate the impact of a routine botulinum toxin type A (BoNT-A) injection in combination with outpatient therapy on the daily activities of stroke survivors with upper extremity spasticity and to facilitate patient-centred assessment focusing on individual needs during daily life. Methods: Design: Observational study across one treatment cycle (3 months).

pmc-12826389.title: Prevalence & correlates of dynapenia in elderly with low skeletal muscle mass: A hospital-based cross-sectional study
pmc-12826389.creator: Tejeswini C.J., Rajath Siddhu, Jehath Syed, Prathiba Pereira
pmc-12826389.description: Background & objectivesDynapenia, an age-related decline in muscle strength independent of muscle mass loss, is increasingly recognised as a predictor of functional decline and adverse health outcomes. This study aimed to investigate the prevalence and predictors of dynapenia among older adults with low skeletal muscle mass.

pmc-13214365.title: Epidemiology, antifungal susceptibility, risk factors, and mortality of adult candidemia at a tertiary hospital in Eastern China from 2020 to 2025
pmc-13214365.creator: Yu-qiong Zhang, Wen-jing Li, Ning Su, Ya-nan Wang, Jing-jing Gao
pmc-13214365.description: BackgroundThis study aimed to investigate the epidemiology, antifungal resistance profiles, and risk factors for 30-day mortality in adult patients with candidemia in Eastern China, ultimately informing improved clinical management strategies.MethodsData on clinical characteristics, blood culture isolates, and antifungal susceptibility were retrospectively collected from the laboratory information system and analyzed for adult patients with culture-confirmed candidemia from 2020 to 2025.

pmc-13290156.title: Reframing Fixation Strategy in Total Knee Arthroplasty With Tibial Bone Density as a Central Criterion
pmc-13290156.creator: Yoshinori Mikashima, Ken Okazaki
pmc-13290156.description: Background:Cementless total knee arthroplasty (TKA) has gained renewed interest with advances in implant design, porous coatings, and surgical accuracy. However, early aseptic loosening continues to be reported, particularly in patients with reduced tibial bone mineral density (BMD). Cemented TKA also demonstrates loosening related to thin or insufficient cement mantles, especially in younger, high-body mass index, or highly active patients.

pmc-13552832.title: Indications for Medical Cannabis and Their Alignment With US-Wide Disease Prevalences in the US’ Largest Medical Cannabis Program: Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-13552832.creator: Sebastian Jugl, Nicole E Smolinski, Tansu Miriam Işılay Aydoğan, Almut G Winterstein, Amaryllis Mavragani, Travis Sanchez
pmc-13552832.description: This research letter compared the prevalence of qualifying conditions among patients certified to use medical cannabis in Florida to population-based prevalence estimates for the same conditions and observed marked discrepancies. These findings highlight conditions that appear to be significant reasons for patients to consider medical cannabis, providing important research priorities for future research on its effectiveness and safety.

pmc-13668388.title: Global, Regional, and National Burden of Heart Failure Attributable to Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease From 1990 to 2021, With Projections to 2050
pmc-13668388.creator: Xiaojing Deng, Huiqing Xu, Yeping Bian, Yunting Xu, Guofeng Ao, Luyan Yang, Ying Ji, Jian Xu, Fei Xu
pmc-13668388.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectivesHeart failure (HF), a common comorbidity of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), is associated with an increased risk of death among patients with COPD. However, no systematic assessment has quantified the population-level burden of comorbid COPD and HF, worldwide.
